title: Quarrystone Labs status (archived capture, 14 June 2017)
text:
Archived capture, 14 June 2017. Quarrystone Labs status.

All systems operational. This page lists every incident we have had since we started publishing it, with a start time, an end time, and a paragraph written by whoever was on call.

Quarrystone Labs shipped a public status page in 2017, which at the time was unusual for a company of eleven people with no enterprise customers to answer to.

Incident log. 3 April 2017: API latency above budget for forty minutes, caused by a migration run during business hours. 22 May 2017: complete outage of eighteen minutes, caused by us.

We will keep this page up even on the days it makes us look bad.
